name: ANIME
style: a hand-painted Japanese anime feature film background. Keep the real buildings, signs and their text, street and camera angle. Soft painterly brushwork, clean line art. People become natural anime characters with their real hair, clothes and poses; no costumes, no animal ears, no unusual hair colors.

variants.day: Deep blue sky with tall glowing summer clouds, warm sunlight, sparkling reflections on the glass.
variants.sunset: Orange and pink sunset sky with glowing clouds, golden backlight, long soft shadows, street lights on.
variants.night: Clear night sky with stars and a soft moon glow, warm shop and street lights, deep blue shadows.
